news.headline: NWS Melbourne Sun Nov 22, 2:30 AM discussion: dry conditions across east central Florida through Monday, rain chances below 10%, highs mid-70s north to low 80s south today and in the 70s Monday; prolonged river flooding continues along the St. Johns River, high rip current risk along the coast and a Small Craft Advisory in offshore waters through early afternoon; rain chances return Tue night into Wed at 40-70%

Construction starts on 20-story Sarasota waterfront tower — 1000 Boulevard of the Arts: Kolter Urban has selected Fort Lauderdale-based Moss to lead construction, with the team mobilizing on site; the mixed-use tower brings 117 luxury condominium residences alongside a Hyatt Centric Harborside hotel replacing the demolished Hyatt Regency Sarasota, residences start at $1.5 million, completion slated for 2028

Builder sentiment at a 14-year low as Florida sales slowed — NAHB/Wells Fargo index fell to 25 in November, the lowest since April 2012, with 46% of builders cutting prices; Florida Realtors October single-family closed sales were 19,049, down 10.1% year over year, median price $420,000 up 2.2%, with new pending single-family sales down 15.7%
news.source: CNBC / Florida Realtors via RoMac Building Supply

news.headline: Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper eases after a sharp fall, but wire costs remain elevated year over year — copper last closed at $5.4850/lb on Fri Nov 20, down 15.3% in the past month; ABC analysis of PPI data put construction input prices up 11.5% year over year in October, with copper wire and cable up 25.5% and iron and steel up 25.1%
news.source: Dalsnafin (Yahoo Finance) / Associated Builders and Contractors

news.headline: Midterm results could accelerate state push for A3 refrigerants — ACHR News: ACCA, PHCC and HARDI warn differing state rules could push ultra-low-GWP A3 refrigerants such as R-290 (propane) before contractors have adjusted to the A2L transition, and urge contractors to monitor state legislation and comment early on proposed refrigerant and code changes

Markets in correction heading into Thanksgiving week — on Fri Nov 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33; for the week the S&P 500 lost 8.6%, its worst week in more than 18 months, as the AI trade unwound; U.S. markets close Thu Nov 26 for Thanksgiving

Mortgage rates Sun Nov 22 — Bankrate's 30-year fixed national average is 7.41% today (7.40% rate / 7.48% APR in its Nov 22 table, as of 6:30 AM); Freddie Mac's weekly average was 7.28% on Nov 19, and Fed minutes from the Oct 27-28 meeting showed almost all officials expect further rate hikes, with the next decision on Wed Dec 9

NBA Sun Nov 22 — both Florida teams play today: Miami Heat (9-6) host the Oklahoma City Thunder at 6 PM ET at Kaseya Center, and Orlando Magic (7-8) are at the Washington Wizards (6-11) at 7 PM ET at Capital One Arena; Magic are without Paolo Banchero (ankle) and Jonathan Isaac (knee)

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Tampa Bay Buccaneers (3-6) at Detroit Lions (7-2) 1 PM ET on FOX, Miami Dolphins (1-8) at Buffalo Bills (8-1) 1 PM ET on CBS, Jacksonville Jaguars (7-2) at New York Giants 4:25 PM ET on CBS
